rate_reference: Independent all-normal-node minimum-image sums, double position difference, actual GetKernel_Fac(float rr2), double gradient, actual C/J/V/p/Ace. Lpair symmetrized C_i+C_j, Lstar=Lpair-Gp dot Lx, divAce receiver C. rate=(Kw/n)*(-theta+k/gamma*(Lstar+rho_water*divAce)); one complete formula checks absence of missing/duplicated contributions.
